Metadata.Title: OpenShips - Licenses for AIS Data Sources
Metadata.Description: The AIS data displayed on this website is provided by various sources. The licenses and required attributions for each data source are listed below. Please note that the data may be subject to additional terms and conditions imposed by the respective data providers.

Metadata.title: OpenShips - Live AIS vessel tracking
Metadata.description: OpenShips is a free and open-source platform for live AIS vessel tracking. Track ships in real-time, view vessel details, and explore maritime traffic worldwide.

hero.title: Connecting ports.
hero.description: An open-source collection of seaports around the world. Structured maritime data, geographic information and identifiers — accessible to everyone.

overview.label: Dataset overview
overview.title: A global perspective on maritime infrastructure.
overview.description: SeaPorts provides a structured collection of seaports worldwide, combining essential port information with geographic data. Built for logistics, research and anyone working with maritime information.

global.title: Global coverage
global.description: A collection of seaports from around the world.

boundaries.title: Port boundaries
boundaries.description: Geographic polygon data for supported ports.

coverage.label: Geographic coverage
coverage.title: From local coastlines to a global network.
coverage.description: The dataset contains port names, identifiers and geographic coordinates worldwide. Detailed geographic boundaries are currently available for ports in Northern Germany, with further expansion planned.

structure.label: Data structure
structure.title: Structured. Accessible. Open.
structure.description: Each port contains a set of geographic and identifying attributes.
structure.note: Geographic boundaries are not yet available for every port.

current.title: Continuous development
current.description: SeaPorts is a work in progress. Port names, UN/LOCODEs and geographic coordinates are available for ports worldwide. Geographic boundaries are currently defined only for Northern Germany.

disclaimer.title: Data accuracy
disclaimer.description: The dataset is provided as-is. Geographic boundaries are approximate and may not represent actual port areas. Always verify information before using it for critical operational or navigational decisions.

license.label: Open source
license.title: Open data. Shared knowledge.
license.description: The dataset is published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. You are free to share and adapt the data with appropriate attribution and indication of changes.

cta.title: Explore the world's seaports.
cta.description: Discover the dataset, inspect the source code and contribute to an open maritime data ecosystem.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.description: Information about the processing of personal data on this website.

responsible.title: 1. Data Controller
responsible.content: The controller responsible for processing personal data on this website is:

hosting.title: 2. Hosting
hosting.content:
This website is hosted on a private virtual server (VPS) provided by STRATO GmbH, Otto-Ostrowski-Straße 7, 10249 Berlin, Germany.

STRATO provides the technical infrastructure required to operate this website. As part of the hosting service, STRATO may process personal data where necessary to provide and secure the infrastructure.

Further information about STRATO's privacy practices is available at https://www.strato.de/datenschutz/.

Where required, processing by STRATO is governed by a data processing agreement pursuant to Article 28 GDPR.

logs.title: 3. Server Log Files
logs.content:
When you access this website, the server automatically processes technical access data. This may include your IP address, date and time of access, requested URL, HTTP status code, amount of data transferred, referrer URL, and information about your browser and operating system.

This data is processed to provide the website, ensure server security and stability, and detect errors or abusive access.

The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest is the secure and reliable operation of the website.

Log data is stored only for as long as necessary for these purposes and is subsequently deleted unless statutory retention obligations or specific security incidents require longer storage.

maps.title: 4. Interactive Map and Map Data
maps.content:
This website provides an interactive map. The map data and tiles required for this feature are delivered by our own tile server, which runs on the same STRATO VPS as this website.

When loading and using the map, your browser sends requests to this server. Technical connection data, in particular your IP address and information about the requested map tiles, is processed in this context.

This processing is necessary to provide the map feature you requested and to ensure its technical operation.

No external map providers are integrated for this purpose.

localStorage.title: 5. Local Storage of Settings
localStorage.content:
This website uses your browser's local storage (localStorage) to save certain settings on your device.

The following information is stored:
- your most recently used map position and zoom level;
- your selected appearance (light or dark mode).

This information is used to restore your settings when you visit the website again. It is not transmitted to external providers.

You can delete this data at any time through your browser settings.

The storage of this information is subject to Section 25 TDDDG and the applicable data protection requirements of the GDPR.

email.title: 6. Contact by Email
email.content:
If you contact me by email, the information you provide, including your email address and the content of your message, will be processed to handle your request.

Depending on the nature of your request, the legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR or Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

The data will be deleted once your request has been fully handled, unless statutory retention obligations or other legitimate reasons prevent deletion.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights

security.title: 8. Encryption
security.content: This website uses SSL/TLS encryption to protect transmitted content from access by unauthorized third parties. You can identify an encrypted connection by the use of https:// in your browser's address bar.
